instruments.evidence: The reader is current_database() on a real NewTest connection, asserted to end in _database; the control shows what a wrong reader produced: omninudge_test_001.
The probe's package directories were shaped the way go test runs a binary, in its package directory under internal/; that shape is what exposed the t.Chdir case.
Naming cases that must work: a flat package, a nested package, upper case, dots and dashes, a directory outside internal/.

A base name without "test" gains it (omninudge -> omninudge_test_models), so a DATABASE_URL pointing at a development database never yields a name ResetTestData would refuse, and never touches the development database itself.
Past the 63-byte Postgres limit: two long paths differing only at the end give two distinct names of at most 63 bytes, and the same path gives the same name again.
Siblings that open a test database: the workers helper moved to TestDSN; the integration helper moves in P2 (see A1); no other opener in internal/.
ensureTestDatabase's name check is still reachable: with TEST_DATABASE_URL unset it now always passes, because every derived name contains test.

CREATE DATABASE: an existing database (42P04, a concurrent run) is success; no permission (42501) returns the one-line ALTER ROLE ... CREATEDB fix; anything else is wrapped with the name. The sync.Once keeps the error, so every NewTest in the binary reports it rather than one.

The new path needs CREATEDB: CI connects as the service superuser; the local user was shown to have it. No migration needs more than owner rights (grep of all 386 files for CREATE ROLE, ALTER SYSTEM, OWNER TO, GRANT to a role, SECURITY DEFINER: none).
The address fallback chain now exists once, in TestDSN; NewTest no longer repeats it.

Every lazily-read input of TestDSN: the working directory (t.Chdir in internal/handlers -- the finding) and the address variables (grep: no test sets TEST_DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL; db_pool_test.go sets only the pool sizes, which NewTest reads on every call, outside the Once).
Packages now run at once, but each in its own database with its own lock; within a package nothing changed. Six concurrent creates: no error.
A failed CREATE DATABASE leaves nothing half made (Postgres creates a database atomically); the error reaches every NewTest.

Package databases are kept on purpose, so later runs only check migrations; a renamed package leaves one idle database locally, and CI runners start empty. The probe dropped all seven databases it made.
The one fix is controlled: the patch makes TestPackageDirIsReadBeforeAnyTestMoves fail with a real assertion (actual omninudge_test_001) and it passes at HEAD.
